# Factor of 2 because slab has two surfaces
gamma = E_diff / (2 * A)  # eV/Å²

print(f"\nSurface energy:")
print(f"  γ = (E_slab - E_bulk) / (2A)")
print(f"  γ = {E_diff:.6f} / (2 × {A:.6f})")
